name: Wheat Flour
description: Finely ground wheat kernel flour commonly used in baking.
health_effects: Can trigger celiac disease or gluten sensitivity symptoms.

name: Skim Milk Powder
health_effects: Contains lactose; not suitable for dairy-allergic or lactose-intolerant individuals.

name: Soy Lecithin
description: Natural phospholipid emulsifier extracted from soybeans.
health_effects: Generally safe, but may cause allergic reaction in people with severe soy allergy.

name: Tartrazine
description: Synthetic lemon yellow azo dye used in foods and beverages.
health_effects: May cause hyperactivity in sensitive children; can trigger hives or asthma in aspirin-sensitive people.

name: Sodium Benzoate
description: Antimicrobial food preservative commonly used in acidic foods and carbonated drinks.
health_effects: When combined with ascorbic acid (Vitamin C), it can form trace amounts of benzene (a carcinogen).

name: Sodium Nitrite
description: Inorganic compound used to cure meats and prevent botulism.
health_effects: Linked to formation of carcinogenic nitrosamines during high-temperature cooking.

name: Citric Acid
description: Naturally occurring weak organic acid found in citrus fruits.
health_effects: Harmless in food amounts; protects against spoilage.

name: Monosodium Glutamate
description: Sodium salt of glutamic acid used to impart umami taste.
health_effects: Widely recognized as safe by WHO and FDA; mild transient sensitivities reported in rare cases.

name: Aspartame
description: Low-calorie artificial sweetener used in diet beverages.
health_effects: Individuals with phenylketonuria (PKU) must strictly avoid it due to phenylalanine content.

name: Peanut Oil
health_effects: Cold-pressed or unrefined peanut oil contains peanut proteins and can provoke severe anaphylaxis.

name: Ascorbic Acid
description: Vitamin C; antioxidant that prevents food discoloration and rancidity.
